description: A kernel booted with ipv6.disable=1: /proc/sys/net/ipv6 does not exist, so neither accept_ra key is implemented and there is nothing for a configuration file to persist. NOT_APPLICABLE rather than FAIL — the distinction this fixture exists for, since a check that concluded 'not set, therefore failing' would report a finding about a stack that is not there. The IPv4 half is fully hardened so the other network checks still reach their real branch.
